caption: The video showcases a metallic construction toy of cylindrical rods joined at spherical nodes, lying in a loose heap on a flat white surface against a plain light-gray backdrop. A large sphere anchors the far left end, another terminates a long arm of rods fanning right, and a tangled cluster of smaller spheres forms a low central mound. Throughout the clip the structure undergoes a slow, small-amplitude settling as the central mound gradually sags and the overall height of the heap decreases slightly. The right-side arm of rods shifts and droops a little relative to its earlier position, while the large left-end sphere and adjacent left rods remain nearly fixed. Individual rods within the central cluster reposition subtly against one another, showing a gentle internal rearrangement rather than a clear rigid-body translation. The visible changes are mostly gradual, with a slight early positional discontinuity. The left sphere's near-fixed position makes the overall framing appear largely stable as the toy adjusts.
